build_conv2d_layer: build a conv2d layer with specified input/output widths, kernel size, stride, and groups
build_patchify2d_layer: build a patchify2d layer for ViT models with specified input/output widths and kernel size
build_se_block: build a Squeeze-and-Excitation block with specified input width and bottleneck width
build_multihead_attention: build a MultiheadAttention block with specified hidden dimension and number of heads
calculate_conv2d_complexity: calculate the FLOPs, params, and activations complexity of a conv2d layer
